assets.scientificFinding: NCBI Taxonomy and Index Fungorum retain Malassezia as the current genus, with Malassezia furfur as its nomenclatural type. Authoritative yeast treatments support globose, ovoid, cylindrical, and bottle-like cells with broad-base monopolar budding. This plate is type-species anchored, representative, non-universal, and non-diagnostic.

The singles include globose, ovoid, bottle-like, and cylindrical forms; each pair contains one ovoid mother and one smaller round bud attached at one broad unipolar base. Counts and groupings match the prompt. Every body is fully inside the centered horizontal social-safe band on a uniformly pale cool field.
